scenes.hook: An A I model and your calendar are different systems. How does an app connect the two?
scenes.idea: The Model Context Protocol, or M C P, standardizes how A I applications connect to tools and data sources.
scenes.demo: A connected service can expose useful information or actions in a structured way the application understands.
scenes.compare: Think of a common connection language. It does not magically give a model access to everything.
scenes.takeaway: Permissions, server trust, and what data gets shared still need careful setup.
scenes.close: Which tool would you connect first? Subscribe to Tech at sixty for clear tech explainers.
